home.sub: 238 components for web, mobile and XR, running on one set of tokens in dark and light. I designed it, wrote every guideline, and built it in React and Figma.

page.title: Nebula
page.lead: A design system for screens you tap, screens you scroll and screens you look through. I built it for my own brand, and to show how I think about systems from the first token to the last guideline.

why.title: Most systems stop at the edge of the phone.
body: Web kits rarely cover mobile gestures. Mobile kits say nothing about a window floating two metres away. XR teams end up rebuilding buttons, cards and alerts from scratch.

Nebula starts from one set of decisions and carries them across all three. A button in a browser, a bottom sheet on a phone and a spatial window in a headset share the same tokens, the same states and the same voice.

principles.title: Say it in the label
principles.body: Buttons are verbs, errors say what to do next, and empty states offer a way forward.

principles.title: Every state is designed
principles.body: Hover, focus, pressed, disabled, loading, error and empty all ship with the component.

principles.title: Colour is never alone
principles.body: Status always pairs a colour with an icon or a word, so it still reads in greyscale.

principles.title: One token, many surfaces
principles.body: Web, mobile and XR read the same token names, so a theme change reaches everything.

principles.title: Comfort before spectacle
principles.body: In XR, targets are 60 pt or larger, windows sit one to two metres away and motion is calm.

type.sample: Clear labels, calm layouts and honest states.

components.title: 238 components in 13 categories.
components.sub: Each one ships with its variants, every state, usage rules, a “when not to use this” note and accessibility guidance.

mobile.title: Thumb-first by default.
mobile.body: 22 mobile components: large titles, tab bars, bottom and action sheets, swipe rows, keypads and card stacks. Every swipe has a tap alternative.

xr.title: Hover means gaze.
xr.body: 29 spatial components: windows, ornaments, gaze rings, radial menus, hand menus and spatial toasts. Dwell and voice back up every pinch.

themes.title: Dark and light from one set of tokens.
themes.body: Every colour token has a dark and a light value, and both are checked for WCAG AA contrast.

items.title: React library
items.body: Every component is a working React component with typed props.

items.title: Figma kit
items.body: Colour and spacing variables, text and effect styles, and all 238 components in dark and light.

items.title: Written guidelines
items.body: Do and don't rules, content guidance and accessibility notes for every component.

closing.title: Want a system like this for your product?
closing.body: I design systems that designers enjoy using and developers can ship.
